context.summary: Current _validate_negative_case dispatches semantic validation only from evidence_type == verification_result. Replace that evidence-type-only gate so canonical finding categories cannot be marked verified by opaque run_record/other JSON after only a digest check.

objective: Replace the evidence-type-only negative-evidence gate with category-aware validation: canonical finding categories (correctness, scope, provenance, security, regression) must require canonical VerificationResult evidence, while non-canonical control-failure evidence types remain allowed.

outputs.description: Unverified candidate patch generated against the frozen source revision.

provenance.source: Phase B2 successor first-five pre-outcome definition

security.notes: Public repository benchmark task. Candidate cannot modify evaluator or benchmark-control artifacts.

validators.description: Worker output must validate as ResultManifest v0.1.
Independent evaluator must verify artifact integrity, scope, transition semantics, and provenance.

verification_policy.acceptance_rule: Both required validators must pass; worker self-report and verifier support are decision evidence, not integration authority.
